verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Zoho Books ships a built-in AI assistant (Zia), so it could plausibly act as an MCP client, but the pack shows no such capability. All MCP evidence describes Zoho MCP in the server role, exposing Books' APIs and actions to external LLM agents such as Claude. Nothing shows Books or Zia connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
